description_en: Queries the status of a data migration task. This is a legacy API
description_zh: 老版查询数据迁移任务的状态
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-migration-job-status --migration-job-id dtsxxxxxxxx --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxxxxx --api-version 2018-08-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeMigrationJobStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration task
parameters.name: migration_job_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

DataInitializationStatus.description_en: The status information of full data migration
DataInitializationStatus.description_zh: 全量数据迁移的状态信息

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the full data migration failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 全量数据迁移失败的错误提示

Percent.description_en: The full data migration progress, in percentage
Percent.description_zh: 全量数据迁移进度，单位为百分比

Status.description_en:
The migration status. Valid values:
NotStarted: not started.
Migrating: migrating.
Failed: migration failed.
Finished: migration completed
Status.description_zh:
迁移状态，返回值：
NotStarted：未启动。
Migrating ：迁移中。
Failed：迁移失败。
Finished：迁移完成

DataSynchronizationStatus.description_en: The status information of incremental data migration
DataSynchronizationStatus.description_zh: 增量数据迁移的状态信息

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the incremental data migration failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 增量数据迁移失败的错误提示

Percent.description_en: The incremental data migration progress, in percentage
Percent.description_zh: 增量数据迁移进度，单位为百分比

Status.description_en:
The migration status. Valid values:
NotStarted: not started.
Migrating: migrating.
Failed: migration failed.
Finished: migration completed.
Catched: no latency
Status.description_zh:
迁移状态，返回值：
NotStarted：未启动。
Migrating：迁移中。
Failed：迁移失败。
Finished：迁移完成。

DestinationEndpoint.description_en: The connection information of the destination instance

DatabaseName.description_en:
The database name.
This parameter is returned only when the destination instance is PostgreSQL or MongoDB
DatabaseName.description_zh:
数据库名称。
当迁移的目标库为PostgreSQL或MongoDB时，才会返回本参数

EngineName.description_en: The database type of the destination instance

IP.description_en:
The endpoint of the destination instance.
This parameter is returned only when the destination instance is a self-managed database connected over Express Connect/VPN Gateway/Smart Access Gateway or a self-managed database with a public IP address
IP.description_zh:
目标库的连接地址。
当迁移的目标库类型为通过专线/VPN网关/智能网关接入的自建数据库或有公网IP的自建数据库时，才会返回本参数

InstanceId.description_en:
The instance ID of the destination instance.
This parameter is returned only when the destination instance is an Alibaba Cloud ApsaraDB instance or a self-managed database connected over Express Connect/VPN Gateway/Smart Access Gateway.
When the destination instance is a self-managed database connected over Express Connect/VPN Gateway/Smart Access Gateway, this parameter returns the VPC ID
InstanceId.description_zh:
目标库的实例ID。
当迁移的目标库为阿里云的云数据库或通过专线/VPN网关/智能网关接入的自建数据库时，才会返回本参数。
当迁移的目标库为通过专线/VPN网关/智能网关接入的自建数据库时，本参数返回VPC ID（即专有网络ID）

InstanceType.description_en:
The instance type of the destination instance. Valid values:
RDS: ApsaraDB RDS instance.
ECS: self-managed database hosted on ECS.
LocalInstance: self-managed database with a public IP address.
MongoDB: ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance.
Redis: ApsaraDB for Redis instance.
PetaData: ApsaraDB for PetaData instance.
OceanBase: ApsaraDB for OceanBase instance.
POLARDB: PolarDB for MySQL cluster
InstanceType.description_zh:
目标库的实例类型，取值：
RDS：阿里云RDS实例。
ECS：ECS上的自建数据库。
LocalInstance：有公网IP的自建数据库。
MongoDB：阿里云MongoDB实例。
Redis：阿里云Redis实例。
PetaData：阿里云PetaData实例。
OceanBase：阿里云OceanBase实例。
POLARDB：阿里云POLARDB for MySQL集群

Port.description_en: The service port of the destination instance

UserName.description_en: The database account of the destination instance

oracleSID.description_en:
The SID of the Oracle database.
This parameter is returned only when the database type of the destination instance is Oracle
oracleSID.description_zh:
Oracle数据库的SID信息。
当迁移的目标库的数据库类型为Oracle时，才会返回本参数

MigrationJobClass.description_en: The specification of the data migration link

MigrationJobId.description_en: The ID of the data migration task

MigrationJobName.description_en: The name of the data migration task

MigrationJobStatus.description_en:
The status of the data migration task. Valid values:
NotStarted: not started.
Prechecking: running the precheck.
PrecheckFailed: precheck failed.
Migrating: migrating.
Suspending: paused.
MigrationFailed: migration failed.
Finished: migration completed
MigrationJobStatus.description_zh:
迁移任务状态，返回值：
NotStarted：未启动。
Prechecking：预检查中。
PrecheckFailed：预检查失败。
Migrating：迁移中。
Suspending：暂停中。
MigrationFailed：迁移失败。
Finished：迁移完成

dataInitialization.description_en: Indicates whether full data migration was performed. The return value is true or false
dataInitialization.description_zh: 是否执行了全量数据迁移，返回值为true|false

dataSynchronization.description_en: Indicates whether incremental data migration was performed. The return value is true or false
dataSynchronization.description_zh: 是否执行了增量数据迁移，返回值为true|false

structureInitialization.description_en: Indicates whether structure data migration was executed. The return value is true or false
structureInitialization.description_zh: 是否执行了结构数据迁移，返回值为true|false

PayType.description_en: The billing method of the data migration task. The return value is fixed as PostPaid (pay-as-you-go)
PayType.description_zh: 迁移任务的付费类型，返回值固定为PostPaid（按量付费）

CheckItem.description_en: The check result of each precheck item
CheckItem.description_zh: 各预检查项的检查情况

CheckStatus.description_en:
The precheck status. Valid values:
NotStarted: not started.
Checking: checking.
Failed: precheck failed.
Success: precheck succeeded
CheckStatus.description_zh:
预检查状态，返回值：
NotStarted：未启动。
Checking：检查中。
Failed：预检查失败。
Success：预检查成功

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the precheck failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 预检查失败的错误提示
ErrorMessage.example: CHECK_ERROR_DEST_USER_PSW##DTS##DTS-002006 Connect db jdbc:mysql://100.100.64.101:17557?characterEncoding=utf8 failure, db user dtstes no connect permission, Please vaild user info. Original error: Access denied for user 'dtstes'@'100.104.52.253' (using password: YES)

ItemName.description_en: The name of the precheck item

RepairMethod.description_en: The method to fix the precheck failure
RepairMethod.description_zh: 预检查失败对应的修复方法

Percent.description_zh: 预检查进度，单位为百分比

Status.description_en:
The precheck status. Valid values:

Checking: checking.
Failed: precheck failed.
Finished: precheck succeeded
Status.description_zh:
预检查状态，返回值：
NotStarted：未启动。
Checking：检查中。
Failed：预检查失败。
Finished：预检查成功
